decisions.source_text: Magic Fates Stance Changes damage in battle with multiplicators. Can be (awakened) to Another Zone . +30% (+60%) for all Magic moves. Also Healing . -30% for all Slash, Piercing, Blunt moves. Another Force (AF) gauge is charged per move when Zone is active , in place of normal per hit charge. 7.5% - AF gain from Magic moves. 0% - AF gain from Slash, Piercing, Blunt moves. 1.5% - AF gain from fixed and self-damage moves. Zone stays in effect until the end of battle, unless overwritten with another Zone. Another Zone Awakening disables overwriting but removes Zone after duration.    zone Stances/Zones
